summary: Stage 0 read: 17 inventory capabilities, all built (impl present), 12 proven current by the 2026-11-08 loop close, 3 stale on the blocked V1 live proof (sigils, player orders, scrub protection), 2 with no recorded proof (breach bias, paint dies with wall). A live walk of a lived-in colony is drafted as the first step of stage 1.
